rationale.surface_lmax: Frozen from pre-panel water convergence to the independent pyddx ddCOSMO scalar; lmax=5 gave an absolute electrostatic difference below 5e-5 eV.
rationale.partition_lmax: Twice surface_lmax so every partition mode visible to P_L M_w P_L is represented.
rationale.transition_width_angstrom2: Inherited unchanged from the pre-existing harmonic MNSol runner; not chosen after observing this profile's panel errors.
rationale.quadrature: Invariant one-dimensional and finite-band coefficient contractions; orders frozen before the panel run.

decision_rule: Run the frozen panel once. Do not adjust lmax, partition bandwidth, transition width, dielectric factor, cavity, CDS, source coefficients, or panel membership after observing its errors. A failure closes this preregistered profile rather than triggering in-panel tuning.
